item.title: Week 10: Jaguars at Titans
item.description: Sun 11/15 · 1:00 PM ET | Line: JAX -10.5 · O/U 45.5 | Model TEN 21% vs. market 17% | On paper, Jacksonville has the edge, led by its 3rd-of-32 ranking in EPA per dropback (+0.29), while Tennessee's best counter is its 6th-ranked defense in broken tackles per touch (10.4% missed) against Jacksonville's 7th (6.2%). Trevor Lawrence ranks 2nd of 31 in EPA per dropback to Cam Ward's 26th, and Parker Washington, who gets 24% of Jacksonville's targets and 33% of its air yards, meets a Tennessee pass defense ranked 30th. The model favors Jacksonville at 79% win probability, driven mainly by the passing matchup (+6.2 points) and the starting quarterback (+3.1 points).
